title_en: 3 Stans Discovery: Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan & Uzbekistan
title_fr: 3 Stans Discovery : Kazakhstan, Kirghizistan et Ouzbékistan
title_ja: 3スタン・ディスカバリー：カザフスタン、キルギス、ウズベキスタン
title_es: 3 Stans Discovery: Kazajistán, Kirguistán y Uzbekistán
summary_en: A 14-day 3 Stans tour from Almaty’s canyons and mountain lakes through Kyrgyzstan’s Issyk-Kul region to Samarkand, Bukhara and Khiva on the Silk Road.

title_en: Ala-Archa Alpine Gorge & Silk Road Burana Tower Day Trip from Bishkek
title_de: Ala-Artscha-Schlucht & Burana-Turm an der Seidenstraße: Tagesausflug ab Bischkek
title_fr: Gorges d’Ala-Archa et tour de Burana sur la route de la soie : excursion depuis Bichkek
title_ja: ビシュケク発 アラ・アルチャ渓谷とシルクロードのブラナの塔 日帰りツアー
title_es: Garganta de Ala-Archa y torre de Burana de la Ruta de la Seda: excursión desde Biskek
seasonNote_en: May to October
summary_en: A private day from Bishkek: a guided walk in Ala-Archa National Park’s alpine gorge, then the 11th-century Burana Tower and its balbal stone warriors.

title_en: Armenia: 5-Day Cultural Discovery
title_fr: Arménie : découverte culturelle en 5 jours
title_ja: アルメニア：5日間カルチャー発見の旅
title_es: Armenia: descubrimiento cultural en 5 días
seasonNote_en: April to June, September to November
summary_en: A 5-day private Armenia tour: Yerevan, Garni and Geghard, Lake Sevan, Dilijan and Haghartsin, Khor Virap, Areni-1 Cave and Noravank. From $1,080 per person.

title_en: Armenia: The 4-Day Legends Tour
title_fr: Arménie : le circuit des légendes en 4 jours
title_ja: アルメニア：4日間レジェンドツアー
title_es: Armenia: el tour de las leyendas en 4 días
seasonNote_en: April to June, September to November
summary_en: A 4-day private Armenia tour from Yerevan: Garni Temple, Geghard Monastery, Lake Sevan, Khor Virap under Mount Ararat, Areni wine and Noravank. From $972 per person.

title_en: Azerbaijan: The 4-Day Explorer Tour
title_fr: Azerbaïdjan : le circuit découverte en 4 jours
title_ja: アゼルバイジャン：4日間エクスプローラーツアー
title_es: Azerbaiyán: el tour explorador de 4 días
seasonNote_en: April to June, September to November
summary_en: A 4-day private Azerbaijan tour from Baku: the UNESCO Old City, Maiden Tower, Heydar Aliyev Center, Yanardag and the Ateshgah Fire Temple. From $726 per person.

title_en: Azerbaijan: The 5-Day Journey Tour
title_fr: Azerbaïdjan : le voyage de 5 jours
title_ja: アゼルバイジャン：5日間ジャーニーツアー
title_es: Azerbaiyán: el viaje de 5 días
seasonNote_en: April to June, September to November
summary_en: A 5-day private Azerbaijan tour: Baku Old City and Heydar Aliyev Center, Yanardag and Ateshgah, plus Shamakhi, Gabala, Nohur Lake and the Tufandag cable car. From $781 per person.

title_en: Bhutan: a 7-day cultural journey
title_fr: Bhoutan : un voyage culturel de 7 jours
title_ja: ブータン：7日間の文化の旅
title_es: Bután: un viaje cultural de 7 días
summary_en: A sample week in western Bhutan. The route links Paro, Thimphu, and Punakha with short walks, long looks, and enough unscheduled time that a guide can adjust the day.

title_en: Bogdanovich Glacier day hike
title_fr: Randonnée d'une journée sur le glacier Bogdanovich
title_ja: ボグダノビッチ氷河のデイハイク
title_es: Excursión de un día al glaciar Bogdanovich
seasonNote_en: Regular season early June to mid-September; a tougher winter version may run from December to February
summary_en: A private day hike from Almaty for fit hikers: the cable car from Medeu to the Talgar pass at 3,200 m, then on foot across moraine to the tongue of Bogdanovich Glacier at 3,600 m and back.

title_en: Charyn Canyon, Kolsai & Kaindy Lakes, 2 days
title_fr: Charyn Canyon, Kolsai & Kaindy Lakes, 2 jours
title_ja: チャリン峡谷、コルサイ湖とカインディ湖、2日間
title_es: Cañón de Charyn, lagos Kolsai y Kaindy, 2 días
seasonNote_en: Spring to autumn (not in winter)
summary_en: A private 2-day trip from Almaty: the Valley of Castles in Charyn Canyon, sunset at the first Kolsai lake, a night in Saty and Kaindy Lake with its sunken spruce forest.

title_en: Chimgan Mountains, Amirsoy Gondola & Charvak Lake Day Trip from Tashkent
title_de: Chimgan-Berge, Amirsoy-Gondel & Charvak-See: Tagesausflug ab Taschkent
title_fr: Monts Chimgan, télécabine d’Amirsoy et lac Charvak : excursion d’une journée depuis Tachkent
title_ja: タシケント発 チムガン山・アミルソイのゴンドラ・チャルヴァク湖 日帰りツアー
title_es: Montes Chimgan, góndola de Amirsoy y lago Charvak: excursión de un día desde Taskent
seasonNote_en: Year-round (gondola weather permitting)
summary_en: A private day in the Western Tian Shan from Tashkent: the Amirsoy Express and Prima cable cars, time on the shore of Charvak Reservoir, and an old plane tree and rock carvings near Bochka.

title_en: Darvaza Gas Crater Evening & Night Excursion from Ashgabat
title_fr: Cratère de gaz de Darvaza : excursion en soirée et de nuit depuis Achgabat
title_ja: アシガバート発 ダルヴァザ・ガスクレーター 夕方〜夜の日帰りツアー
title_es: Cráter de gas de Darvaza: excursión de tarde y noche desde Asjabad
seasonNote_en: March to May, September to November
summary_en: A private same-day trip from Ashgabat: one of the city’s big bazaars, the drive north across the Karakum Desert via the village of Erbent, then evening and a barbecue dinner at the burning Darvaza Gas Crater.

title_en: The Long Road Through the 5 Stans
title_de: Der lange Weg durch die 5 Stans
title_fr: La longue route à travers les 5 Stans
title_ja: 5つのスタンを巡る長い道
title_es: El largo camino por los 5 Stans
summary_en: A 22-day 5 Stans tour from Bishkek to Ashgabat: Tash-Rabat and Issyk-Kul, Charyn Canyon and Almaty, Dushanbe and Iskanderkul, Samarkand, Bukhara and Khiva, then the Darwaza Gas Crater.

title_en: Four Stans Odyssey
title_fr: Four Stans Odyssey
title_ja: フォー・スタンズ・オデッセイ
title_es: Four Stans Odyssey
summary_en: An 18-day 4 Stans tour of Central Asia through Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan and Uzbekistan: canyons and mountain lakes, Khujand and Penjikent, the Seven Lakes, then Samarkand, Bukhara and Khiva.

title_en: Garni Temple, Geghard Monastery & Lake Sevan Day Trip from Yerevan
title_de: Garni-Tempel, Kloster Geghard & Sewansee: Tagesausflug ab Jerewan
title_fr: Temple de Garni, monastère de Guéghard et lac Sevan : excursion depuis Erevan
title_ja: エレバン発 ガルニ神殿・ゲガルド修道院・セヴァン湖 日帰りツアー
title_es: Templo de Garni, monasterio de Geghard y lago Seván: excursión desde Ereván
seasonNote_en: Year-round
summary_en: A private day from Yerevan: the Charents Arch view of Ararat, Garni Temple, the Symphony of Stones, UNESCO-listed Geghard and Lake Sevan’s Sevanavank Monastery.

title_en: Gobustan Rock Art, Mud Volcanoes & Absheron Fire Tour from Baku
title_de: Gobustan-Felsbilder, Schlammvulkane & Feuer von Abscheron: Tagestour ab Baku
title_fr: Pétroglyphes de Gobustan, volcans de boue et feux d’Abşeron : excursion depuis Bakou
title_ja: バクー発 ゴブスタン岩絵・泥火山・アブシェロンの火 日帰りツアー
title_es: Arte rupestre de Gobustán, volcanes de lodo y fuegos de Absherón: tour desde Bakú
seasonNote_en: Year-round
summary_en: A private day from Baku: UNESCO-listed Gobustan petroglyphs, bubbling mud volcanoes above the Caspian, Bibi-Heybat Mosque, the Ateshgah Fire Temple and Yanardag.

title_en: Harbin Ice and Snow World, Sun Island & St. Sophia Private Day Tour
title_de: Harbin Ice and Snow World, Sonneninsel & Sophienkathedrale – Private Tagestour
title_fr: Harbin Ice and Snow World, île du Soleil et Sainte-Sophie – excursion privée d’une journée
title_ja: ハルビン氷雪大世界・太陽島＆聖ソフィア大聖堂 1日プライベートツアー
title_es: Harbin Ice and Snow World, isla del Sol y Santa Sofía – tour privado de un día
seasonNote_en: Late December to February
summary_en: A private winter day in Harbin: the giant snow sculptures on Sun Island, the ice buildings of Ice and Snow World, then St. Sophia Cathedral and the cobbled Central Street (Zhongyang Street).

title_en: Harbin, China Snow Town & Changbai Mountain: 7-Day Winter Tour
title_de: Harbin, China Snow Town & Changbai-Gebirge: 7-tägige Winterreise
title_fr: Harbin, China Snow Town et mont Changbai : circuit d’hiver de 7 jours
title_ja: ハルビン・中国雪郷・長白山：7日間の冬のツアー
title_es: Harbin, China Snow Town y monte Changbai: tour de invierno de 7 días
seasonNote_en: November to February
summary_en: A 7-day winter tour of Northeast China from Harbin to Jilin: China Snow Town’s lantern-lit roofs, a Dream Snow Mountain hike and snowmobile ride, Jingpo Lake ice fishing, Changbai Mountain’s Heavenly Lake, volcanic hot springs and a ski day on Songhua Lake.

title_en: Iskanderkul Alpine Lake & Fann Mountains 4WD Day Trip from Dushanbe
title_fr: Lac Iskanderkoul et monts Fann : excursion en 4x4 depuis Douchanbé
title_ja: ドゥシャンベ発 イスカンデルクル湖とファン山脈 4WD日帰りツアー
title_es: Lago Iskanderkul y montes Fann: excursión en 4x4 desde Dusambé
seasonNote_en: May to October
summary_en: A private 4x4 day from Dushanbe over the Anzob Pass into the Fann Mountains: glacial Lake Iskanderkul, the 43-metre “Fann Niagara” waterfall and Snake Lake.

title_en: Kraków & the Jura: 7 Days Outdoors in the Polish Jurassic Highlands
title_de: Krakau & Jura: 7 Tage draußen im Polnischen Jura
title_fr: Cracovie et le Jura polonais : 7 jours en plein air
title_ja: クラクフとポーランド・ジュラ高地：アウトドアの7日間
title_es: Cracovia y el Jura polaco: 7 días al aire libre
summary_en: A 7-day outdoor trip from Kraków into the Polish Jurassic Highlands: Wawel and Kazimierz, then a countryside hotel among limestone cliffs, with Ojców National Park, Pieskowa Skała Castle, a cycling day, beginner climbing or via ferrata, and a day with a nature guide.

title_en: Active Winter in Poland: Kraków, Katowice & the Beskids in 9 Days
title_de: Aktiver Winter in Polen: Krakau, Kattowitz & Beskiden in 9 Tagen
title_fr: Hiver actif en Pologne : Cracovie, Katowice et les Beskides en 9 jours
title_ja: アクティブな冬のポーランド：クラクフ、カトヴィツェ、ベスキディ山脈9日間
title_es: Invierno activo en Polonia: Cracovia, Katowice y los Beskides en 9 días
seasonNote_en: Winter, from late November (Kraków’s Christmas market) to March (snow in the Beskids)
summary_en: A 9-day winter trip in southern Poland: three nights in Kraków, a night in Katowice with the Nikiszowiec miners’ estate, and three nights at a Beskid ski resort with a beginner ski lesson, snow tubing and spa time.

title_en: Kraków & Zakopane in Winter: 7-Day Trip
title_fr: Cracovie et Zakopane en hiver : voyage de 7 jours
title_ja: 冬のクラクフとザコパネ 7日間
title_es: Cracovia y Zakopane en invierno: viaje de 7 días
seasonNote_en: Winter, ideally late November to December for Kraków’s Christmas market
summary_en: A 7-day winter trip in southern Poland: three nights in Kraków for Wawel Castle, Kazimierz and the Christmas market, then three nights in Zakopane under the Tatra Mountains with a cable car, a sleigh ride and hot springs.

title_en: Kyrgyzstan: 8 days on nomad trails
title_fr: Kirghizistan : 8 jours sur les pistes nomades
title_ja: キルギス：遊牧の道を行く8日間
title_es: Kirguistán: 8 días por senderos nómadas
summary_en: A sample arc from Bishkek to high pasture and a long lake, then back. Yurt camps and guesthouses stand in for named hotels. Horse riding is an offer, not a test.

title_en: Learn to Ski in Poland: 9 Days in the Beskid Mountains
title_de: Skifahren lernen in Polen: 9 Tage in den Beskiden
title_fr: Apprendre à skier en Pologne : 9 jours dans les Beskides
title_ja: ポーランドでスキー入門：ベスキディ山脈9日間
title_es: Aprender a esquiar en Polonia: 9 días en los Beskides
seasonNote_en: Winter snow season, usually December to March
summary_en: A 9-day beginner ski trip in Poland: fly into Kraków, then six nights at a Beskid resort in Szczyrk, Wisła or Ustroń with beginner lessons, gentle slopes and hotel spas.

title_en: Poland Christmas Markets: Poznań, Wrocław & Karpacz in 9 Days
title_de: Weihnachtsmärkte in Polen: Posen, Breslau & Karpacz in 9 Tagen
title_fr: Marchés de Noël en Pologne : Poznań, Wrocław et Karpacz en 9 jours
title_ja: ポーランドのクリスマスマーケット：ポズナン、ヴロツワフ、カルパチ9日間
title_es: Mercados navideños de Polonia: Poznan, Breslavia y Karpacz en 9 días
seasonNote_en: Christmas market season, late November to December
summary_en: A 9-day Christmas market trip in western Poland: three nights in Poznań with a croissant and a potato workshop, two in Wrocław for its market and gnomes, two in Karpacz in the Karkonosze mountains, and a last night in Poznań.

title_en: Samarkand in a Day: High-Speed Train Tour from Tashkent
title_de: Samarkand an einem Tag: Schnellzug-Tagestour ab Taschkent
title_fr: Samarcande en un jour : excursion en train à grande vitesse depuis Tachkent
title_ja: タシケント発サマルカンド日帰りツアー：高速鉄道アフラシャブ号で行く1日観光
title_es: Samarcanda en un día: excursión en tren de alta velocidad desde Taskent
style_en: Private Silk Road day tour by Afrosiyob high-speed train
seasonNote_en: Year-round (best March to June and September to November)
summary_en: A private full-day trip from Tashkent to Samarkand on the Afrosiyob high-speed train, with your guide waiting at Samarkand station, a private car in the city, lunch, and visits to Gur-e-Amir, Registan Square, Bibi-Khanym Mosque, Siyob Bazaar, Shah-i-Zinda and the Ulugh Beg Observatory.

title_en: Tashkent & Chimgan Mountains: 5-Day Private Tour
title_fr: Tachkent et monts Tchimgan : circuit privé de 5 jours
title_ja: タシケント＆チムガン山脈：5日間プライベートツアー
title_es: Taskent y montes Chimgan: tour privado de 5 días
seasonNote_en: Year-round (best March to November; ski season December to February)
summary_en: A 5-day private Uzbekistan tour based in Tashkent: two city days from the Khast Imam Complex and Chorsu Bazaar to Amir Timur Square, plus a mountain day at Amirsoy, the Chimgan Mountains and Charvak Lake.

title_en: Turgen Gorge & Assy Plateau, 2 days
title_fr: Turgen Gorge & Assy Plateau, 2 jours
title_ja: トゥルゲン峡谷とアッシ高原、2日間
title_es: Turgen Gorge & Assy Plateau, 2 días
seasonNote_en: Summer only
summary_en: A private 2-day trip from Almaty in summer: a forest hike to Kairak waterfall in Turgen Gorge, a night at our glamping camp, then a full off-road day on the Assy Plateau at about 3,000 m.
